title: Slice 626931: [Expense Agent] Lost receipt workflow and document creation (November '26)
summary: The Expense Agent now allows users to submit expenses without a receipt by selecting a 'No Receipt' option, which generates a standardized document, attaches it automatically, and applies enhanced compliance controls through policy-based settings.
key_points: No Receipt workflow enables expense submission when original receipt is missing
System auto-generates a standardized Lost Receipt document and attaches it as proof
Policy-based controls: administrators can allow/disallow, set maximum amounts and frequency limits
Marked expenses are assigned Non-Compliant status and require approver review
New enums and codeunits handle No Receipt declaration, management, and validation
